item.title: 'Zero-Cost Abstraction' Isn't a Slogan: I Put Rust's trait and C++'s virtual Function in the Same Assembly and Counted the Call Sites
item.description: 'Zero-cost abstraction' is the most-quoted claim in Rust circles, and 99% of the posts quoting it never show assembly. Same polymorphic dispatch (generic trait / dyn / C++ virtual) in three versions, x86-64 asm from rustc 1.99 + gcc 13, call sites inspected line by line: monomorphization under -O2 generates no function at all (inlined into the caller); dyn is callq *%r15, same shape as C++'s call *(%rax) — the tax didn't disappear, it moved to another path.
